notes: Matcher extensions for unusual barcodes. Regex match rules (a third rule type alongside Starts with / Contains; the pattern is validated before it is saved). Opt-in auto-detect: when no assignment or rule matches, pull the well count (6/12/24/48/96/384/1536) out of the barcode and select that microplate - the number must be delimited so an embedded serial like 0096 never false-matches.
